items.source: PropertySource implementation that reads properties from an underlying Spring JndiLocatorDelegate.
items.translation: PropertySource 实现，用于从底层的 Spring JndiLocatorDelegate 读取属性。

items.source: Uses of JndiLocatorDelegate in org.springframework.jndi
Configure a JndiLocatorDelegate with its "resourceRef" property set to true, meaning that all names will be prefixed with "java:comp/env/".
items.translation: 配置一个 `JndiLocatorDelegate`，将其 "resourceRef" 属性设置为 `true`，这意味着所有名称都将以前缀 "java:comp/env/" 开头。

items.source: Create a new JndiPropertySource with the given name and the given JndiLocatorDelegate.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 `JndiPropertySource`，使用给定的名称和给定的 `JndiLocatorDelegate`。

items.source:
The classes in this package make JNDI easier to use,
facilitating the accessing of configuration stored in JNDI,
and provide useful superclasses for JNDI access classes.
items.translation: 该包中的类使 JNDI 更易使用，便于访问存储在 JNDI 中的配置，并为 JNDI 访问类提供有用的超类。
